steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: Close the door, we gotta go!

steps.speaker: Legionnaire
steps.content: Hey, it's not my fault that things have turned out this way. Anyway... let's go after them! Go!
All the vehicles press down on the gas pedals almost at the same time, setting off at top speed. Over a dozen Legion motorbikes have shot out from the alley and are chasing after you now.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahaha, what an honor to have warranted this many guys from the Legion to welcome us—wait, they're drawing their weapons!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Leave it to me from here.
As she's speaking, Hecate pushes open the car door. Facing the wind, she simply climbs onto her Nightmare and hops sideways onto the pickup truck's cargo.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you gonna screw them up? Count me in!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No need. Your arms are too short, you can't reach them.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stay in the car and protect the Chief. I'll deal with the other enemies.
